_source: markings and dimensions: nhl_spec.py (NHL Official Rules, sec. 1). Ice appearance and paint colour: rink_reference_2026-08-13.png (1024x1536). Camera angle and lens: fitted to that photo by measure_photo.py + fit_photo.py.
_anchor: The photo sets how the ice LOOKS and where the camera IS. The rulebook sets every dimension. The photo cannot do the latter: it disagrees with itself by up to 2.14 m between halves, and its rink is 44 m long against the regulation 61.
